title: Optimality of Gerver's sofa
abstract: Formalizes Baek's solution of the moving sofa problem: Gerver's sofa attains the supremum of the areas of closed connected shapes that can move continuously around a right-angled corner in a unit-width hallway. Includes certified Gerver parameters, admissibility, convex cap geometry, Stieltjes curve area, Jordan separation, polygon approximation, and the concave quadratic upper bound.

informal.MovingSofa.sofaConstant_eq_volume_gerver: The supremum, in extended nonnegative real numbers, of the areas of all admissible moving sofas equals the area of the explicitly defined Gerver sofa.
informal.MovingSofa.GerversSofa.ABφθSpec.existsUn: Gerver's four defining equations have exactly one quadruple of parameters with A and B nonnegative and 0 ≤ φ ≤ θ ≤ π/4.
informal.MovingSofa.isMovingSofa_gerversSofa: Gerver's sofa is closed and connected and admits a continuous rigid motion from the horizontal arm to the vertical arm, starting at the identity and remaining within the unit-width hallway throughout.
